chunks: Among what was narrated by Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: A man urinates and does not have water with him, so he wipes his private part with the wall. He said: Everything dry is pure.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone wipes himself with a dry surface after urinating when no water is available?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning cleaning after urination when water is unavailable. Imam Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام states that a dry object is pure, indicating the jurisprudential significance of dryness in questions of ritual purity.
